coordinate_meaning: coverage at one original pixel; values from 0 to 1
geometry: Existing graph-distance unfolding positions; axes are addresses on the map, not individual original pixel axes.
limitations: A finite sampled sheet, not the full continuous surface.
Unwrapped distances can differ from original image distances.
Between sampled vertices the coordinate-field colors and contours are interpolated.
All original values are retained at vertices. This is data attachment, not a claim of a continuous learned decoder.

understanding_check.object: One unwrapped sheet with actual original pixel values attached at every sampled vertex
understanding_check.axes: Map addresses versus original pixel-coordinate values are distinguished explicitly
understanding_check.baseline: Root image and its two selected coordinate values are marked
understanding_check.evidence: Two original coordinate fields on the same addresses; interactive full-vector inspection
understanding_check.scope: Bit-exact source values at finite vertices; approximate map and between-vertex interpolation
